snippet.title: Labyris - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the world of Labyris — an atmospheric, puzzle-driven journey set in a mysterious, forgotten realm.

This teaser gives you a glimpse into the haunting beauty and enigmatic challenges that await. Are you ready to face the maze?

⚡ Add to your Steam Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3659010/Labyris/

🔔 Subscribe to stay updated: youtube.com/@GandujaInteractive
📅 Full trailer & release date coming soon.
